title: HR Coördinator Nederland
description: Wil jij jouw HR-ervaring inzetten binnen een internationale organisatie die de gezondheidszorg vooruithelpt? Als HR Coördinator Nederland ben je een belangrijke schakel in onze HR-dienstverlening. Je zorgt ervoor dat personeelsadministratie en lokale HR-processen efficiënt, zorgvuldig en in lijn met wet- en regelgeving worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega’s om medewerkers en managers optimaal te ondersteunen. Jouw rol Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en leidinggevenden binnen jouw aandachtsgebied in Nederland. Je ondersteunt hen bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken en biedt praktische, oplossingsgerichte begeleiding. Je werkt zelfstandig aan dagelijkse HR-zaken en stemt bij complexere onderwerpen af met senior HR-collega’s en managers om tot de beste aanpak te komen. Wat ga je doen? Beheren van de HR-administratie van de volledige employee lifecycle, waaronder instroom, uitdiensttreding, verzuimregistratie, personeelsdossiers en HR-documentatie. Proactief bewaken van aflopende contracten en verzorgen van werkgeversverklaringen en referenties. Ondersteunen van leidinggevenden bij de onboarding van nieuwe medewerkers. Ondersteunen bij lokale HR-communicatie, updaten van intranetcontent en vraagstukken op het gebied van arbeidsverhoudingen. Opbouwen en onderhouden van sterke (nationale en internationale) werkrelaties met HR Shared Services collega’s, de HR Officer, HR Business Partners, andere HR-specialisten en Centers of Excellence. Op verzoek adviseren over Nederlandse arbeidswetgeving, compliance, HR-systemen, werkwijzen en procedures; daarnaast leidinggevenden ondersteunen en informeren op basis van passende richtlijnen. Samenwerken met senior HR-collega’s aan organisatieverandering, zoals reorganisaties, fusies, overnames en (internationale) overplaatsingen van medewerkers, met oog voor lokale wet- en regelgeving. Met minimale begeleiding bijdragen aan de dagelijkse ontwikkeling en implementatie van lokale en wereldwijde HR-initiatieven. Opstellen van HR-rapportages en analyses voor senior management. Actief bijdragen aan continue verbetering om de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening te verhogen, interne verwachtingen te overtreffen en een professionele HR-organisatie verder te versterken. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde opleiding op HBO niveau 1–2 jaar ervaring binnen HR of met personeelsadministratieve processen; ervaring binnen HR Shared Services is een pre. Je beheerst het Nederlands vloeiend en hebt een goede professionele beheersing van het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Goede kennis van de Nederlandse arbeidswetgeving. Goede kennis van Microsoft Office, met name Excel; ervaring met Workday en DocuSign is een pre. Je weet binnen bestaande richtlijnen en procedures de juiste afwegingen te maken en passende acties te ondernemen. In staat om meerdere werkzaamheden te prioriteren en coördineren en deadlines effectief te bewaken. Je communiceert gemakkelijk op alle niveaus en bouwt sterke relaties op met medewerkers, managers en andere stakeholders. Zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en een echte teamspeler, met het vermogen om effectief te werken binnen een internationale matrixorganisatie. title: Legal Specialist
description: Legal Specialist Overview IQVIA is seeking an experienced and commercially minded Legal Specialist to support the negotiation and administration of customer agreements within our global laboratory business. This role offers the opportunity to work with international stakeholders across Europe, America and Asia, supporting a wide range of complex contractual activities while partnering closely with legal, commercial, finance, and operational teams. The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing customer contracts while ensuring alignment with IQVIA policies, legal requirements, and business objectives. This position requires strong contract negotiation expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global environment where flexibility, curiosity, and problem-solving are essential. Key Responsibilities Contract Drafting & Negotiation Draft, review, revise, and negotiate a broad range of laboratory customer agreements, including Master Service Agreements, amendments, confidentiality agreements, and other commercial contracts. Independently negotiate legal and operational contract terms while identifying matters requiring senior attorney review or escalation. Prepare signature-ready execution copies and support the full contract lifecycle from initiation through execution. Conduct follow-up discussions with customers regarding draft and finalized agreements to ensure timely completion of negotiations. Contract Management & Compliance Manage contract tracking and reporting through internal contract management systems. Maintain complete and accurate contract files and documentation. Review agreements for compliance with current contracting standards, policies, and approved fallback language. Produce contract status reports, including tracking agreements approaching expiration or renewal periods. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as a key point of contact and subject matter expert for assigned customers. Partner with Sales, Business Operations, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and contractual implications. Collaborate with internal legal counsel and external customer representatives, including senior management and legal advisors. Support customer satisfaction by facilitating efficient and professional contracting processes. Legal Research & Process Improvement Conduct legal research and analysis related to contractual matters and business requirements. Contribute to the development and enhancement of departmental procedures and best practices. Participate in global legal negotiation teams to drive consistency, quality, and process excellence. Support departmental initiatives aligned with business growth, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction objectives. Qualifications Required Education Bachelor's Degree in Law, Business, or a related field. Paralegal certification or comparable legal qualification preferred. Required Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in contract management, contract negotiation, paralegal services, commercial legal operations, or a related legal function. Experience reviewing, negotiating, and drafting complex commercial agreements. Experience working directly with legal counsel and cross-functional business teams. Previous experience within a corporate legal department, life sciences, healthcare, laboratory, pharmaceutical, CRO, or professional services environment is highly desirable. Experience gained either within an in-house legal team or private legal practice will be considered. Skills & Competencies Technical Expertise Strong understanding of contract law principles and commercial contracting practices. Proven ability to negotiate contractual language beyond standardized templates and forms. Knowledge of legal research methodologies and compliance requirements. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. Comfortable utilizing digital tools and AI-enabled technologies to improve productivity and efficiency. Professional Skills Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong attention to detail with excellent proofreading and editing capabilities. Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to explain contractual concepts clearly to business and customer stakeholders. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Personal Attributes Curious, adaptable, and comfortable working with incomplete information while identifying solutions. Resilient and proactive approach to managing complex negotiations. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative global team. Strong relationship-building skills with internal and external stakeholders. Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and exercising sound professional judgment. Why Join IQVIA? At IQVIA, you will join a truly global legal and contract negotiation team supporting one of the world's leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organizations. This role offers exposure to international business operations, complex commercial negotiations, and opportunities to work alongside experienced legal and business professionals in a dynamic, global environment. description: Overview IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research. The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care. The ILS & PASS science team comprises dedicated qualitative scientists and COA development scientists. Presently it does not have a team of dedicated statisticians and psychometricians. Owing to the large body of work – mostly internally funded – the team is recruiting for a Statistics and Psychometrics Lead, one entry-level Statisticians/Psychometrician, and one Statistical Programmer to support the teams’ activities, as described below. The Statistician/Psychometrician and Statistical Programmer roles will report to the Statistics and Psychometrics Lead. The Statistical Programmer role is described below. Role & Responsibilities The Statistical Programmer will be expected to: (1) Empirically develop scoring rules & program scoring algorithms for existing COA measures For instruments being added to IQVIA ILS library, generate standard scoring documentation, and program simulation datasets, Data Quality Evaluation (DQE), and scoring of domains on these datasets Implement new statistical features in the random generation of data, to simulate real-world instrument data with certain psychometric properties Implement new, more advanced statistical capabilities in user tools (Insights Hub, PROCore) Work cross-functionally with non-statisticians/psychometricians in the PACT and ILS & PASS teams (2) Provide programming support for the development of new COA measures & endpoints Program classical and modern psychometric analyses and analyses of meaningful thresholds Program high frequency and continuous DHT data collaborate with data scientists to support algorithm validation, and verification of digital measure performance across diverse datasets and devices. About You Knowledge, skills and abilities Candidates must have: (a) statistical and psychometric research skills; and (b) strong computer skills, including Base SAS with macro (R skills, API experience). Connecting to databases with SAS/R, and programming with validation/QC in a regulated environment would be an advantage. Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality. Candidates must be able to: (a) work within a team environment, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships; (b) confidently communicate with, and effectively present information to, internal and external teams; and (c) work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects. Candidates should have extensive familiarity and demonstrable experience with AI tools and their application to the topics mentioned above. Education and experience Candidates should have a relevant qualification in statistics or psychometrics, experience in statistical programming, and an interest in patient-centered research (including COA and/or DHT) and clinical research (pharmaceutical, or healthcare industry).
